items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: And a brother named Kinson had that band, you know. And he showed the people how he could bring these little youngses up, you know.

ctx.x: I asked him which came first.

We had some band, too. Most of our jobs called for white people. We said. We was up three years before we could play for one color people. And the first time we played for color people when Joe Oliver left from the air. You know, the thing I got in there when I was standing right by Joe Oliver with a fellow drumming him, Buddy Sali. Hit him in the eye with a wheel by the hammer. And you know, I thought Joe would be one eye, you know. And he used to have a man, Carol, all them boys. He must have been around about…
I asked you who this Bourne was. That's not Harrison Bourne.
